subject: Virtual full-loop: condensed two-block schedule + standby rotation
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>

Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Virtual full-loop: condensed two-block schedule + standby rotation

Hi Aisha —

Thanks again for your interest in the Senior Infra Engineer role. We’d like to run a condensed virtual full-loop to keep things efficient while giving you the same breadth of interviews. Proposed plan (all times PST):

- Option A (preferred): Tuesday, Nov 24 — Block 1: 10:00–12:00 (deep dives: system design + infra coding) | Block 2: 14:00–15:30 (product/behavior + hiring manager)
- Option B: Wednesday, Nov 25 — same blocks; if you prefer both blocks back-to-back we can tighten the lunch gap to 45 minutes.

Interview sequencing idea: start with a short 20-min systems anchor, then an extended design interview, followed by a paired coding session. We’ll roster standby interviewers who can step in if someone needs to drop (we call this the "standby rotation") to avoid reschedules.

Attaching your resume (from your application) and our candidate runbook so you can see the cadence and what to expect. Can you let me know which of the two dates works and whether you prefer Block 1 first or having the hiring manager earlier? Also tell me your timezone if PST isn’t ideal.

Quick logistical notes:
- We’ll send calendar invites with Zoom links and a prep doc 48 hours before the loop.
- Each interviewer will have a 10-minute debrief buffer after their slot (short, focused).

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Recruiting Program Manager | Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
